insights: The market shows a clear upward trajectory, with the current 7-day average (1428) consistently outperforming the 30-day average (1408), signaling sustained hiring momentum.
Software Engineering remains the primary engine of growth, while Unicorn-tier companies are demonstrating higher stability and volume compared to the more volatile FAANG+ segment.

While Data Engineering has seen a short-term contraction, the overall market breadth is expanding, suggesting that companies are prioritizing core product development and AI-integrated roles for new graduates.
